name: Folmi
provenance: Simplified editable vector redraw of approved D3; not an exact trace or replacement for the generated App icon.

rules.interruptRule: Higher priority wins; a task lifecycle event may replace working or thinking. Error and attention remain until acknowledged. Idle never interrupts an active task.
rules.eventQueue: Do not queue repeated success, greeting, or attention animations. Coalesce repeated events. One visible mascot per surface.
rules.placement: Titlebar or reserved accessory space; never over terminal output, text selection, or input.
rules.smallSizeRule: Below 32 px use a still silhouette. At 16 px omit highlights and use open or closed eyes only.
rules.pause: Freeze animation time and preserve the selected state; do not cancel a task.
rules.colorRule: Use amber and charcoal in every state. No flashing, red alarm, purple, or forest green.

idle.label: 待命
idle.motion: Still body; one short blink per cycle. No constant bobbing.

working.label: 工作中
working.motion: Eyes look slightly down; tail makes a quiet 2 degree sweep. No fabricated progress.

thinking.label: 思考中
thinking.motion: Eyes glance upward; ear moves once gently each cycle.

success.label: 已完成
success.motion: One small nod and brief amber rays; happy closed eyes.
success.exit: Return to the previous sustained state after 900 ms

attention.label: 需要你看看
attention.trigger: An actionable decision requires the user
attention.motion: Ear lifts once; head leans 2 degrees, then holds still.
attention.exit: User acknowledges or resolves the decision

error.label: 遇到问题
error.motion: Ear lowers once and eyes narrow; no shaking, flashing, or bouncing.
error.exit: User acknowledges, retries, or dismisses the error

sleep.label: 休息
sleep.trigger: The window is inactive and no operation is running
sleep.motion: Closed eyes with less than 1 percent breathing scale; stop entirely while offscreen.
sleep.exit: Window focus or a task starts

greeting.label: 你好呀
greeting.trigger: First intentional reveal of the session
greeting.motion: One light tail wave and 3 degree lean; never on each keystroke or tab switch.
